args.lesson: Verdict STOP / park. What worked: two pricing-page FETCHes plus one flattening EXEC were enough to settle the question. Stotles publishes a GBP 0 free tier and self-serve 'upcoming expiring contracts' from GBP 50-75/month, and Tussell sells competitor award and renewal tracking through annual subscriptions. Both cover a wider version of our 3-notice job, and we also have no collection route. What failed: BidStats returned 403, so it stays unobserved. Next time: check the incumbents' self-serve price floor before publishing any free procurement-intelligence page. If a free tier from a funded incumbent already covers the job, a hand-made sample brief cannot become a paid offer. Reopen only on a classified REQUEST or a collection route.
